verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents camera-directed avatar videos (`type: "cinematic_avatar"`) with multi-shot prompts, cinematic motion and scene direction, plus text-prompted cinematic scenes and consistent wide, medium and close-up framing. That is a first-party capability for directing the camera rather than accepting default motion. However, direction appears to be prompt-based, and the evidence never names discrete camera-move controls or shows they are reliably honored. missing for 10: explicit pan/zoom/orbit/static move parameters, documentation of how camera instructions are specified and honored, independent or hands-on corroboration of camera-control fidelity.
